title: Kyun aale mohammed
body:
Hussain ya Hussain....x8
Kyu Aal e Mohammed laye gaye bazaron me darbaron ne..x2
Kyu Aal e Mohammed laye gaye bazaron me darbaron me
Kyu ehle haram par zulm huwe bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed......
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye kalm goh tu yeh to bata kyu hashr kiya tune barpa
Masuma ke dur kyu chine kya Aal e Mohammed ki thi khata
Kya ajre risalat hain yeh hi urwan me kya
Ahkam e deen mitayega yeh bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyu sath yeh kausar ke pyare darya ke kinare pyase the
Ashur ke din woh asr talak be jurmo khata sab qatl Huwe
Lut aisi machi fir Karbobala me parda raha na khayme rahe
Qaidi ghut ghut ke rote gaye bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed......
<<DIVIDER>>
Ha deen khuda ka baki raha ghar Fatema Zahra ka juda
Shabbir ka lasha ran me raha Quran sina par sar ne lasha
Sajjad e hazeen tha qaidi magar har mod pe usne khutba diya
Aur parcham e haq lehraye gaye bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed......
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Qaim e Aal e Mohammed hain woh laal hain Binte Payambar ka
Bechain hain parda e ghaibat me woh waris tere Haider ka
Woh khoon ke aansu rota hain hain dukhi Zainab ki chadar ka
Kis tarha un par zulm huwe bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed....
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Kufe walon yaad karo is shehar ki main shehzadi thi
Aur masturate Kufa ko tafseer ka darz bhi deti thi
Main Shah e Najaf ki beti hoon maa Binte Payambar meri thi
Sain bibi ne khutbe diye bazaron me darbaron me Kyu Aal e Mohammed.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain
Ya Hussain.....x4
Hussain ya Hussain.....x6
